data.keyword: What's the best password manager for a small team?

result.keyword: What's the best password manager for a small team?
result.markdown:
For most small teams, I'd recommend **1Password or Bitwarden**\.

My overall pick is **1Password for ease of use and team collaboration**, while Bitwarden is the better choice if keeping costs down is a priority.

A business password manager should do more than store passwords. It should let you\:

- Share logins securely without sending passwords through Slack or email.
- Control who can access particular accounts.
- Remove access immediately when someone leaves.
- Generate strong, unique passwords.
- Monitor weak, reused or compromised passwords.
- Manage everything centrally through an admin console.

## Best options compared

![1Password 8.12 - TidBITS](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/34HDvvYhqgd6AnMFmrlTm3hAXFxcbeGEwY_LB_XZ_XGVtrk4a2QxTEX-2LBZt2GGXhIIaKEolAWfkyjqt2bzeCs60tKyMvcGjArpm-vdyy1ZPxujq2f9_l2uItYJrXcwCcU9bPBSy8AGv_Ou2YF6Ce5xYeilxXBZ8f7ED4T1F4V2OwIPdBn46M8zBrxXTO4w?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. 1Password**

(Best overall for usability)

- Excellent shared vaults and permissions.
- Easy for non-technical employees.
- Strong admin controls and security monitoring.
- Good integrations with business tools.

**Pricing\:** Teams Starter Pack around US\$24.95/month for 10 users; Business US\$8.99/user/month.

[1Password business plans](https://1password.com/business)

---

![Free High-Quality Bitwarden Logo for Creative Design](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/p0IJzf2NCUQ2t02rqtPWDpe7Tx4YGCRNleASv1NjpztaDI--7OD-0zWJhdBi_4Wn4-v0Hr3hoS6JA2KXHdCOlvvdfHelZm6tTBmFuxgAbBftLkdqobRCpEkp4ysyI4Rm6vafJPMfHi8ri9Tdeng_QKXRw7C7a5ESA6hn8XLhRMLnvM7oFmwZESsO4_SFLJaX?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. Bitwarden**

(Best value)

- Open-source foundation.
- Secure shared collections.
- Centralised team administration.
- Good security and directory integrations.
- Self-hosting options.

**Pricing\:** Teams around US\$4/user/month.

[Bitwarden business plans](https://bitwarden.com/business/)

---

![Keeper Security Logo PNG,  Vector (AI, EPS, CDR, PDF, SVG) - iconLogoVector](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/hjZLLtGaZjkKvsDiCoIrNA749yx3vMYIFoRmmV0blB-pAj7O30nu3RJOVVhVRwgAOkJUfJ3datZ7pfH1wp7yeplrEL3FQ-HNOpCzlVOW0OcMr1CFjIFAx50apRkdH6sYOH31WcP6gfXOxeAN8qubYhHhGYA5yXp1bc7wqtCxjN2WEQuyMALTG1Pwne14BXyG?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Keeper Security**

- Good administrative controls.
- Shared team folders.
- Strong security and compliance features.
- Useful for businesses with more complex access requirements.

**Pricing\:** Business plans start around US\$2/user/month for the Starter tier.

[Keeper business plans](https://www.keepersecurity.com/business.html)

---

![Test Dashlane : un gestionnaire de mots de passe élégant et complet, mais trop avare - Les Numériques](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/66TJUMmYmc2uHzIsxHHiAx7hxRQ8alP8a248IQqZpKMw5qyY_k9MeFr4rutufsLjTYxUl32XmJycQKSNVtCaRTxRhBdFKuuN8SD7uZ8vs9JkSCZSzdZ2yIQm88TGjWCrg-h07fJdRP7X6VdOalsZe2e6fj_Ou1dMYyLIEbt_d4hajtzL8hVlKJz2qWk0Hm2z?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Dashlane**

- Polished interface.
- Password health monitoring.
- Phishing and credential risk protection.
- Useful security reporting.

**Pricing\:** Business pricing around US\$8/user/month in published comparisons.

[Dashlane business plans](https://www.dashlane.com/business)

Pricing is indicative, in USD, generally based on annual billing. Check Australian pricing and GST at checkout. Sources: [toolsandthrive.com](https://toolsandthrive.com/best-password-manager-for-small-business/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[cybercred.com.au](https://cybercred.com.au/articles/password-managers-compared-for-small-business?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.softwarecompare.net](https://www.softwarecompare.net/comparison/best-password-manager-for-business?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

## My recommendation

I'd narrow it down to these two\:

| Priority | My choice |
|--------|--------|
| Easiest for staff | 1Password |
| Best price/features | Bitwarden |
| More complex administration | Keeper |
| Extra credential-risk monitoring | Dashlane |


For a small business, I wouldn't pay enterprise prices unless you genuinely need advanced identity management, SSO or compliance features.

## Three questions to narrow it down

I can make a more specific recommendation if I know\:

**1\. How many people need access?**

---

**2\. What does your team primarily use?**

---

**3\. What's most important?**
